rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a poorly expanded early blastocyst with absent/indistinct ICM and sparse TE, consistent with 1DD; minor issue is some uncertainty around exact expansion stage and limited mention of zona features.
Strongly integrates age, prior live birth, tubal factor, AMH, BMI, endometrium, sperm parameters, and lifestyle with the poor embryo morphology to frame prognosis.

Overall logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately driven by very poor embryo quality despite favorable patient factors; minor inconsistency around day-4/blastocyst terminology and a few speculative comments.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, luteal support, hydrosalpinx evaluation, caution with add-ons, and restrained use of PGT-A in a 27-year-old. Small deviations include some overstatement of morphology-driven miscarriage risk and informal lifestyle advice.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, hydrosalpinx assessment, review of embryo development patterns, and when to consider PGT-A.
